benchmark.host: GitHub Actions ubuntu-24.04 x86_64 Intel Xeon 6973P-C virtualized
benchmark.classification: single-host exploratory timing regression signal, not established cross-host slowdown or speedup

cost.scope: function static x86-64 disassembly through first ret; not whole image

decision: DO NOT submit current x - q*y replacement as profitable Cranelift optimization. The same-Wasm compiler edit reduces static divq and function bytes but shows a slower in-process paired ratio on one hosted CPU. No general speed claim or compiler-pass proof.
next_direction: Explore true dual-result x86 div lowering with both quotient and remainder from one instruction, via target-gated multi-result CLIF/egraph or post-lowering deduplication. Independently check trap ordering, SSA dominance, register liveness, flags/poison assumptions, signed overflow, cross-target effects and profitability against same-Wasm patched compiler.
